hourlyTemperature: ASHRAE station design data with 1997 Ch28 hourly correction basis
orientation: ASHRAE 1997 Ch29 solar orientation tables, PDF pp.29.29-29.35
fenestrationU: ASHRAE 1997 Ch29 Table 5, pages 29.8-29.9, U-Factors for Various Fenestration Products
interiorAttenuation: ASHRAE 1997 Ch29 Tables 25, 26, and 29, PDF pp.29.38, 29.40
slabBasement: ASHRAE 1997 Ch28 interior-surface heat gain method, PDF pp.28.28-28.29
interiorSurfaces: ASHRAE interior-surface transmission method: Q = U x A x (Tadjacent - Tindoor); ASHRAE 1997 Ch28 pp.28.28-28.29
groundFloorCooling1997: ASHRAE 1997 Ch28 p.28.7, Heat Gain through Interior Surfaces floor note after Eq.8: ground-contact floor heat transfer may be neglected for cooling load estimates
infiltration: ASHRAE 1997 Ch25 Table 3, Tables 6 and 8, and Eq.46; Ch28 Eqs.22-23
nasaSolar: NASA/Open-Meteo solar irradiance mapped to DNI/DHI/GHI and solar position
